laws.rule: Guerrero (including Acapulco, Zihuatanejo and Taxco) charges a state lodging tax on paid stays in hotels, motels, timeshares, campsites, inns, guest houses, suites, villas and bungalows, and in whole houses, apartments or rooms. The rate is 4% of the amount paid, or 5% for casual tourist lodging (houses, apartments, villas and similar non-hotel stays, including those booked through a digital platform). It is added to the bill: the lodging provider, or a booking platform that takes the payment, collects it and pays it to the state. Meals and other services that aren't lodging, and VAT, are outside the base (Ley 419 de Hacienda del Estado de Guerrero, art. 57 to 60).

sources.title: Ley Número 419 de Hacienda del Estado de Guerrero (latest changes published 23 December 2025)

local-law.notes: Only the state lodging tax is checked. Acapulco beach and street-drinking rules, state alcohol hours and park rules aren't checked.
